thread:
Maya K: Quick design pass on the Private setup wizard the network prereq step is confusing when checks fail. Users get a big dump of logs and no clear next action. Can we make failures more prescriptive and keyboard-friendly?

Samir: Saw a support ticket where user said nothing was focused after the error. Also the error language is very engineering-heavy.

Jordan L: Example of what we're currently showing: ```
socket.connect failed: timeout
ERR_CODE=NET_TIMEOUT
stack: ...
```
Proposal: show a short human line like "Could not reach the host" with a help hint and a collapsible "Advanced details" area for logs.

Olivia: Accessibility priorities: announce failures via a live region and move focus to the first actionable control (Retry / Run diagnostic). The collapsed logs must be reachable by keyboard and labelled.

Maya K: Copy suggestion: title = "Connectivity check", message = "We couldn't reach your host. Check hostname, port (default 5678), and firewall rules." Primary button: "Run quick network diagnostic" Secondary: "Contact support". Keep it short and prescriptive.

Samir: For the diagnostic flow, prefer a small modal overlay rather than inline expansion so we can trap focus and show a simple pass/fail summary plus a download link for raw logs. The modal should also include a one-click command users can run: `nc -vz 10.0.1.5 5678`.

Jordan L: Agree on progressive disclosure. Also map common HTTP/network codes to plain language (e.g., 504 -> "Gateway timeout: port may be blocked"). Don't spit back stack traces in the main step.

Olivia: I'll update the Figma frames: 1) compact error pill with aria-live, 2) primary action labelled as Maya's copy, 3) collapsible advanced details with proper aria-controls/expanded attributes, 4) modal spec for diagnostics. Also will do a color-contrast tweak on the error icon  current pink fails WCAG at 14px.

Maya K: UX question: should we surface an inline quick checklist (DNS, port, TLS) with icons? Might help non-technical users self-troubleshoot.

Samir: Yes but keep it collapsed by default. Each checklist item can expand to show an exact command and a copy button. Make sure copy button announces success to screen readers.

Jordan L: Implementation note: raw logs downloadable as `.log` and never rendered raw in the DOM. Add server-side truncation and a link to request full logs via support if needed.

QA-bot: prereq-check ran at 2024-10-02T09:12:47Z. Sample failing host: 10.0.1.5:5678, observed RTT 31200ms.

Olivia: I'll push the mock files and a11y annotations. Samir, can you prototype the modal and the advanced collapse behaviour?

Samir: Yep will prototype and ping for review. :rocket:
